title: Standalone TABLECONTENT standard base-style ID output

scope.operation: Write standard TABLECONTENT column, row and cell base-style IDs while preserving the rooted TABLESTYLE handle edge.
scope.profile: Generated AC1027 standalone TABLECONTENT with a locally authored NOD-rooted TABLESTYLE; one 2x2 grid exercises IDs 1/2/3 on column/row/cell, and one 1x1 cell exercises ID 2; ASCII and binary input/output cross-product.
scope.source_basis: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 §20.4.102 identifies ID 1 as title, 2 as header, 3 as data, ID 4 as table beginning in R24, and custom IDs from 101. The serializer already emitted the selected group-90 fields but rejected all nonzero IDs; the rooted adapter validated base-style IDs only for legacy TABLE records, not standalone TABLECONTENT.
implementation: Admit standard standalone TABLECONTENT base-style IDs 1-3 in column, row and cell fields, and require a nonzero TABLESTYLE reference whenever any such ID is used.
Validate standalone IDs against both source and target versions in the adapter, then include the TABLESTYLE handle in the rooted ACAD_TABLESTYLE output plan.
Continue to refuse ID 4 and custom IDs >=101 until standalone CELLSTYLEMAP ownership and ID resolution are qualified.
scope.claim_boundary: Selected generated AC1027 DXF transport for IDs 1-3 across standalone TABLECONTENT column/row/cell fields and 1x1/grid serializer branches. This does not qualify ID 4, custom CELLSTYLEMAP IDs, native table rendering, or DWG output.

evidence.physical_wire: An independent DXF walker verifies group 90 values 1/2/3 for grid column/row/cell profiles, ID 2 in the 1x1 cell profile, zero IDs in peer positions, and each TABLECONTENT group-340 handle joins the emitted TABLESTYLE group-5 identity.
evidence.typed_readback: Fresh imports preserve each selected base-style ID and resolve both TABLECONTENT objects to the emitted TABLESTYLE.
evidence.failure_controls: ID 4, custom ID 101 and an unrooted 0xDEAD TABLESTYLE target are refused; destination sentinels and caller fields remain unchanged.
evidence.retry_control: Restoring standard ID 3 or the rooted TABLESTYLE handle permits same-adapter retry and typed readback.

research.source: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 §20.4.102 CELLSTYLEMAP
research.finding: IDs 1/2/3 denote title/header/data, ID 4 denotes table beginning in R24, and custom style IDs begin at 101. CELLSTYLEMAP is connected to TABLESTYLE through its named extension-dictionary entry.

remaining: Resolve and emit standalone TABLECONTENT ID 4 and custom IDs only with exact rooted CELLSTYLEMAP closure and version checks.
The parent P5 phase remains open; broader formatting combinations, renderer semantics, and DWG output are not claimed.
